item.title: About Me
item.description:
I am a B.Tech student at IIIT Naya Raipur, specializing in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence.

I am an ardent tech enthusiast who loves working on various domains of this ever-growing tech industry.

I am passionate about open source contributions, get excited about latest developments in the field of AI and automation.

I am also keen about understanding the ever so amazing world of Web 3.

I am quite zealous about systems programming the nitty-grities of Operating Systems such as Linux.
